coerced-numeric-string: speed as a string must not be coerced to a number (FR-TEL-001)
unknown-as-false: ignition is tri-state; false is not a legal stand-in for unknown (FR-TEL-002)
synthesised-without-algorithm: synthesised identity must declare how it was derived
identifier-in-asset-ref: references must be pseudonymous, never a plate or identity number
missing-provenance: every event carries its raw hash and adapter version
impossible-latitude: impossible coordinates are rejected, not silently clamped
